title: Look Up and Seek Him
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Amos was walking with his sheep
And picking figs to eat;
He was no prophet, just a man
With dust upon his feet.

[Chorus]
"Seek Me, and you will live," He said,
"Look up and you will see;
I made the seven stars, and I
Am waiting. Look for Me."

[Verse 2]
The Lord looked down and picked him out,
"Go tell them what I say."
So Amos left his sheep behind
And walked the long, long way.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
The people had forgot to look,
Their hearts had wandered far;
But Amos said, "Look up and seek
The One who made each star."

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
Like Scout who looked beneath the couch
And found his marble there,
I'll keep on looking for the Lord
And know He's always there.

[Chorus]
mood: Looking-up music. A light, even strum under the voice, like a child walking a field path with their chin tipped up, sure the stars are still there in the daytime. Soft ukulele keeping the walk, an upright bass stepping underneath, one plain young voice. Curious and glad rather than grand, brightening a little at every chorus, music for the middle of a clear day.
